name: proto-blocks/oit-related-blogs
title: OIT Related Blogs
description: Auto-queries recent published blog posts and renders them as vertical cards (featured image, date, category tag chips, title with chevron) under a 'Related Blogs' heading with an optional 'View all blogs' button. Excludes the current post on a single post view. Use near the bottom of the blog template.

limit.label: Max posts
limit.help: How many recent posts to show.
